_meta.source: Curated subset of common Medicare LCD/NCD-supported diagnosis-to-procedure pairings. NOT a complete coverage policy database. Used only as a deterministic first-pass check before deferring to the LLM reasoner.
_meta.schema: Each procedure_code maps to a list of ICD-10 prefixes that are commonly accepted as supportive. A match is at the prefix level (e.g., 'M17' matches 'M17.11').

modifier_rules._meta: Minimal modifier validity rules. The coding extractor uses these as a deterministic first pass.
modifier_rules.25: Significant, separately identifiable E/M service on the same day as another procedure. Required when an E/M code is billed with a procedure on the same DOS.
modifier_rules.26: Professional component. Used when only the professional component of a service is billed.
modifier_rules.59: Distinct procedural service. Used when two services are normally bundled but were performed in distinct sessions or sites.
modifier_rules.LT: Left side. Required for paired-organ procedures performed on the left.
modifier_rules.RT: Right side. Required for paired-organ procedures performed on the right.
modifier_rules.50: Bilateral procedure. Used when a procedure was performed on both sides during the same session.
